description: This file defines the PersonSearchCriteria class used for building search predicates and query joins related to Person entities, attributes, and patient data within the OpenMRS platform's Hibernate-based data access layer.

classes.name: PersonSearchCriteria
classes.description: A utility class for constructing search criteria involving person attributes and patient data for querying the database.

methods.name: preparePredicateForAttribute
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate for searching attributes based on value, voided status, and match mode.

methods.name: addAliasForAttribute
methods.description: Creates a LEFT JOIN between Encounter and Patient for attributes.

methods.name: addAliasForAttributeType
methods.description: Creates a LEFT JOIN between Attribute and AttributeType.

methods.name: getAttributeMatchMode
methods.description: Retrieves the global property for attribute match mode and returns the corresponding MatchMode enum.
